boundary_evidence: Lower edge 0x020bfec0 is the overlay .text base (the ov006 .text section starts there), so nothing precedes it.
Upper edge 0x020c4048: the next linker unit begins there (tu_map), and its data starts at 0x0213af18, after this unit's last data word 0x0213aee8.
93 functions, contiguous, every one a one-function shard that already byte-matched; no gaps inside 0x020bfec0..0x020c4048.

Data windows are exclusive: all 45 distinct ov006 data targets referenced from the run lie in 0x0213ac48..0x0213aee8, 0x0213ad28, 0x0212b890, 0x0212b89c, 0x0212b8fc, 0x0212c9e4, and none is referenced from outside the run.
bss 0x021402e0..0x021402fc belongs to the one function-local static (guard word, destructor node, Vector3) in FallingPetal_Spawn.
No RTTI, vtable or sinit record separates the run into smaller units, so interior boundaries are unproven and it is folded whole as the tu_map unit.

bss 0x021402e0..0x021402fc: the guard, registration node and storage of FallingPetal_Spawn's function-local static unit-Y Vector3. Only FallingPetal_Spawn refers to the three addresses; the overlay's .bss starts at 0x021402e0, and the next word (0x021402fc) is read by d_mg3d_heyho_obj_adapter.
